title: Solo Qualifier
core_verb: Run and jump through a compact obstacle course toward the finish line.
fantasy: A playful televised obstacle-course qualifier, greyboxed as elevated platforms, rotating bars, moving gates, and a finish platform.
fail_state: The round timer reaches zero before the finish line is crossed, or the player touches the out-of-bounds kill volume.
win_state: Cross the finish line before the round timer reaches zero.

interaction_tags.meaning: Rotating bar, swinging block, or moving gate that knocks the player toward delays or out-of-bounds areas on contact.
Kill volume below and beside the course; touching it immediately eliminates the player.
Helper marker collected when passed; records the player's latest course checkpoint for progress verification.
Goal trigger at the end of the course; crossing it before timeout wins the round.

notes: Fall Guys' multiplayer 60-player elimination format is reduced to one solo qualifier loop: traverse a single obstacle course and cross the finish line before the timer expires, with no opponents, placements, or qualification quota.

scene.description: A brightly coloured televised obstacle course floating above a void, candy-coloured and swept by studio spotlights. Elevated platforms, spinning hurdle bars and checkpoints lead to a finish platform under a giant banner. Confetti drifts in the air, crowd silhouettes and sponsor banners ring the course and foam padding lines the edges; moderate, with a clear run-up between obstacles.
